I have invited Ashlee Martinez, Vickie Powell, and David Martinez to your "Camping Trip Planning" Todoist project. I have also added the following items to your Amazon cart:

- 3 x Black Diamond Apollo Lantern
- 2 x Into The Wind 10-ft. Delta Kite
- 3 x NEMO Tensor Insulated Sleeping Pad
- 1 x Cressi Panoramic Wide View Mask Dry Snorkel Set

The total cost is **$1,586.47** (including tax and shipping). I plan to use your **Home** address for delivery. You have two valid payment cards: **MasterCard (ending in 3738)** and **American Express (ending in 6439)**. Please confirm which card I should use to place the order so I can proceed with the remaining tasks (Splitwise group, expense logging, and Venmo requests).
